title: Deep Tendon Reflexes — Technique, Grading and Reinforcement

hook.en: A reflex hammer is the most honest tool in the clinic: the patient cannot fake it. Learn where to tap, how to grade 0–4+ and why a "bad" reflex is often a bad technique.
hook.ur: Reflex hammer clinic ka sab se imandar tool hai: patient isay fake nahi kar sakta. Seekhein kahan tap karna hai, 0–4+ grade kaise dena hai aur ek “kharab” reflex aksar kharab technique kyun hota hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll tap six reflexes with the right position, grade them 0–4+, use reinforcement and say what a brisk or absent reflex points to.
goal.ur: End tak aap chhe reflexes sahi position mein tap karenge, unhein 0–4+ grade denge, reinforcement use karenge aur batayenge ke brisk ya gayab reflex kis cheez ki taraf ishara karta hai.

text.en: A deep tendon reflex is a **stretch reflex**: tapping the tendon stretches the muscle spindle, the signal races to the spinal cord, connects to the motor neuron and the muscle contracts — all without the brain. That loop is the **reflex arc**. The brain normally holds it in check from above, so damage to the pathway **above** the arc makes reflexes brisk, and damage to the arc itself (root or nerve) makes them reduced or absent.
text.ur: Deep tendon reflex ek **stretch reflex** hai: tendon par tap karne se muscle spindle stretch hota hai, signal spinal cord tak jata hai, motor neuron se jurta hai aur muscle contract hota hai — dimagh ke bagair. Yeh loop **reflex arc** hai. Dimagh normally isay upar se qabu mein rakhta hai, is liye arc se **upar** ka nuksan reflexes ko brisk kar deta hai, aur khud arc (root ya nerve) ka nuksan unhein kam ya gayab kar deta hai.

text.en: The reflex arc is a thermostat in a house. The brain is the owner who can turn the dial down. If the owner's control wire is cut (an upper motor neuron lesion), the heater runs wild — brisk reflexes. If the thermostat's own wire is cut (a root or nerve lesion), the heater never starts — absent reflexes.
text.ur: Reflex arc ghar ka thermostat hai. Dimagh malik hai jo dial neeche kar sakta hai. Agar malik ki control wire kat jaye (upper motor neuron lesion) to heater be-qabu chalta hai — brisk reflexes. Agar thermostat ki apni wire kat jaye (root ya nerve lesion) to heater shuru hi nahi hota — gayab reflexes.

text.en: **Count up the body:** **1–2** (S1–S2) Achilles, **3–4** (L3–L4) knee, **5–6** (C5–C6) biceps and brachioradialis, **7–8** (C7–C8) triceps. Add the medial hamstring for **L5**.
text.ur: **Jism par upar ginein:** **1–2** (S1–S2) Achilles, **3–4** (L3–L4) knee, **5–6** (C5–C6) biceps aur brachioradialis, **7–8** (C7–C8) triceps. **L5** ke liye medial hamstring add karein.

intro.en: Watch the technique: the leg hangs relaxed, the examiner finds the patellar tendon between the kneecap and the bump on the shin, and strikes briskly. Use the **Reflex grade** buttons to see how 0, 1+, 2+, 3+ and 4+ look.
intro.ur: Technique dekhein: taang dheeli latki hui hai, examiner kneecap aur shin ke bump ke beech patellar tendon dhoondta hai aur tezi se strike karta hai. **Reflex grade** buttons se dekhein ke 0, 1+, 2+, 3+ aur 4+ kaise lagte hain.

title.en: The five rules of a good tap

steps.title: Relax the patient
steps.detail: A tense limb has no reflex. Support the joint, ask the patient to let go, and distract with conversation. || Patient ko relax karein

steps.title: Find the tendon with your fingers first
steps.detail: Press on the tendon so you know exactly where it is, then strike your own finger or the tendon directly. || Pehle ungliyon se tendon dhoondein

steps.title: Strike briskly and let the hammer bounce
steps.detail: Swing from the wrist, not the elbow, and let the head rebound. A slow press is not a tap. || Tezi se strike karein aur hammer ko uchalne dein

steps.title: Put the muscle on slight stretch
steps.detail: A little tension on the tendon gives the spindle something to fire. Do not overstretch. || Muscle ko halka stretch par rakhein

steps.title: Always compare both sides
steps.detail: Same tap, same position, then the other limb. A difference between sides matters far more than the grade of one reflex. || Hamesha dono sides compare karein

rows.ur: Reinforcement ke bawajood koi response nahi

rows.en: Absent: root, nerve or muscle problem (or a poor technique)
rows.ur: Gayab: root, nerve ya muscle ka masla (ya kharab technique)

rows.en: Present but reduced, or only with reinforcement
rows.ur: Maujood lekin kam, ya sirf reinforcement se

rows.en: Diminished: mild root or nerve problem, or normal in some older people
rows.ur: Kam: halka root ya nerve masla, ya kuch buzurgon mein normal

rows.en: Normal, a brisk but controlled movement
rows.ur: Normal, tez lekin qabu mein movement

rows.en: Normal: compare with the other side
rows.ur: Normal: doosri side se compare karein

rows.en: Brisk, may spread to nearby muscles
rows.ur: Brisk, qareeb ke muscles tak phail sakta hai

rows.en: Suspicious: normal in anxious or athletic people, UMN sign if asymmetrical or with other signs
rows.ur: Mushkook: ghabraye ya athletic logon mein normal, asymmetrical ya doosre signs ke saath UMN sign
Bohat brisk, sustained clonus ke saath

question.en: The right knee jerk is 3+, the left is 2+, and the right calf feels stiff. What is the best next step?
question.ur: Right knee jerk 3+ hai, left 2+, aur right calf sakht lagti hai. Behtareen agla qadam?

text.en: Look for other UMN signs (clonus, Babinski, tone, weakness) and refer if new
text.ur: Doosre UMN signs (clonus, Babinski, tone, kamzori) dhoondein aur naya ho to refer karein

feedback.en: Yes — an asymmetrical brisk reflex plus stiffness suggests an upper motor neuron problem, so check for clonus and the plantar response.
feedback.ur: Haan — asymmetrical brisk reflex aur sakhti upper motor neuron masle ka ishara hai, is liye clonus aur plantar response check karein.

text.ur: Tasalli dein — 3+ hamesha normal hota hai

feedback.en: A symmetrical 3+ can be normal, but an asymmetry with stiffness is not.
feedback.ur: Symmetrical 3+ normal ho sakta hai, lekin sakhti ke saath asymmetry normal nahi.

text.en: Treat the right knee with stretching only
text.ur: Sirf right knee ko stretching dein

feedback.en: Find the cause first; the finding may be neurological.
feedback.ur: Pehle wajah dhoondein; finding neurological ho sakti hai.

text.en: **The three technique errors:** (1) a tense limb — the patient is holding the muscle; (2) striking the wrong place — a few centimetres off the tendon gives a dull thud; (3) giving up too early. If a reflex is absent, **reinforce** and try again before calling it absent.
text.ur: **Technique ki teen ghaltiyan:** (1) tense limb — patient muscle ko pakre hue hai; (2) ghalat jagah strike — tendon se chand centimetre door sust thud milti hai; (3) jaldi haar maan lena. Agar reflex gayab ho to gayab kehne se pehle **reinforce** karein aur dobara try karein.

intro.en: Place your thumb on the biceps tendon, strike your thumb, and watch the elbow flex. Try the grade buttons again, then switch sides — the technique is a mirror image.
intro.ur: Apna thumb biceps tendon par rakhein, thumb par strike karein aur elbow ko flex hota dekhein. Grade buttons dobara try karein, phir side badlein — technique ka aks hai.

text.en: **Reinforcement (Jendrassik manoeuvre):** for a reflex in the legs, ask the patient to hook their fingers together and pull apart; for a reflex in the arms, clench the teeth or press the knees together. It briefly lifts the brain's inhibition and brings out a hidden reflex. Document the reflex as "knees 2+ with reinforcement" so the next therapist knows.
text.ur: **Reinforcement (Jendrassik manoeuvre):** taang ke reflex ke liye patient se ungliyan hook kar ke alag khenchne ko kahein; arm ke reflex ke liye daant bhinchein ya ghutnay dabayein. Yeh dimagh ki inhibition ko thori der ke liye hata kar chhupa hua reflex nikalta hai. Reflex ko “knees 2+ with reinforcement” likhein taake agla therapist jaan sake.

text.en: Reflex grades are **moderately reproducible** between examiners; agreement is better for absent versus present than for 2+ versus 3+. That is why asymmetry, the pattern across many reflexes and other signs (tone, weakness, clonus, Babinski) matter more than one number. Anxious, young or athletic people may have symmetrically brisk reflexes, and older adults may lose ankle jerks with age.
text.ur: Reflex grades examiners ke beech **moderately reproducible** hain; maujood-vs-gayab ka agreement 2+ vs 3+ se behtar hai. Isi liye asymmetry, kayi reflexes ka pattern aur doosre signs (tone, kamzori, clonus, Babinski) ek number se zyada ahem hain. Ghabraye, jawan ya athletic logon mein reflexes symmetrically brisk ho sakte hain, aur buzurgon mein umar ke saath ankle jerks ghayab ho sakte hain.

question.en: Which root level does the **biceps** reflex test?
question.ur: **Biceps** reflex kaun sa root level test karta hai?

feedback.en: Yes — biceps and brachioradialis are the "5–6" reflexes.
feedback.ur: Haan — biceps aur brachioradialis “5–6” reflexes hain.

question.en: A knee jerk seems absent on the first tap. What should you do before calling it absent?
question.ur: Pehli tap par knee jerk gayab lagta hai. Gayab kehne se pehle kya karein?

text.en: Relax the limb, check the tendon position and reinforce with the Jendrassik manoeuvre, then tap again
text.ur: Limb relax karein, tendon ki jagah check karein aur Jendrassik manoeuvre se reinforce karein, phir dobara tap karein

feedback.en: Yes — most "absent" reflexes are tense limbs or a missed tendon. Only an absent reflex after reinforcement is truly absent.
feedback.ur: Haan — zyada tar “gayab” reflexes tense limb ya chhooti hui tendon hoti hain. Reinforcement ke baad bhi gayab ho tabhi sach mein gayab hai.

text.en: Record it as absent and move on
text.ur: Gayab likh kar aage barh jayein

feedback.en: That risks a false finding from poor technique.
feedback.ur: Kharab technique se jhoota finding ban sakti hai.

feedback.en: Harder is not better; a brisk, accurate tap works, a heavy blow just hurts.
feedback.ur: Zor se behtar nahi; tez aur sahi tap kaam karti hai, bhaari chot sirf takleef deti hai.

question.en: A patient has absent ankle jerks on both sides but normal knee jerks. What pattern is this, and what common cause should you think of?
question.ur: Patient ke dono ankle jerks gayab hain lekin knee jerks normal hain. Yeh kaisa pattern hai aur kaun si aam wajah sochein?

answer.en: A distal-first loss of reflexes points to a **peripheral polyneuropathy** (for example diabetes, B12 deficiency, alcohol). Ankle jerks go first because the longest nerves are affected earliest. Check sensation in a glove-and-stocking pattern and the feet.
answer.ur: Door wale (distal) reflexes ka pehle jana **peripheral polyneuropathy** ki taraf ishara hai (maslan diabetes, B12 ki kami, sharab). Ankle jerks pehle jaate hain kyunke sab se lambi nerves pehle affect hoti hain. Glove-and-stocking pattern mein sensation aur pairon ko check karein.

summary.en: A stretch reflex runs through the spinal cord: damage above the arc makes it brisk, damage to the arc makes it reduced or absent.
summary.ur: Stretch reflex spinal cord se guzarta hai: arc se upar ka nuksan isay brisk karta hai, arc ka nuksan isay kam ya gayab.

summary.en: Good technique wins: relaxed limb, tendon found by touch, brisk wrist tap, slight stretch, both sides — and reinforce before calling a reflex absent.
summary.ur: Acchi technique jeetti hai: relaxed limb, touch se tendon dhoondna, wrist se tez tap, halka stretch, dono sides — aur reflex ko gayab kehne se pehle reinforce karein.

summary.en: Asymmetry and the whole pattern matter more than any single grade; distal-first loss means neuropathy, brisk plus clonus means UMN.
summary.ur: Asymmetry aur poora pattern kisi ek grade se zyada ahem hain; distal-first loss matlab neuropathy, brisk plus clonus matlab UMN.

front.en: Roots of the biceps, brachioradialis, triceps, knee and ankle reflexes?
front.ur: Biceps, brachioradialis, triceps, knee aur ankle reflexes ki roots?

front.en: What is reinforcement and when do you use it?
front.ur: Reinforcement kya hai aur kab use karte hain?

back.en: Jendrassik manoeuvre (clench teeth, hook fingers and pull) to bring out a reflex that seems absent.
back.ur: Jendrassik manoeuvre (daant bhinchna, ungliyan hook kar ke khenchna) jo gayab lagne wala reflex nikalta hai.

front.en: What does a brisk reflex with clonus suggest?
front.ur: Clonus ke saath brisk reflex kis ki taraf ishara karta hai?

back.en: An upper motor neuron lesion above the reflex arc.
back.ur: Reflex arc se upar upper motor neuron lesion.

front.en: Which reflex pattern suggests peripheral neuropathy?
front.ur: Kaun sa reflex pattern peripheral neuropathy batata hai?

back.en: Reduced or absent ankle jerks first, symmetrically, with distal sensory loss.
back.ur: Pehle ankle jerks kam ya gayab, symmetrically, aur distal sensory loss ke saath.

goDeeper.title: Reflexes skill in the Skills Lab

note.en: Strike every reflex in 3D and try all five grades.
note.ur: Har reflex 3D mein strike karein aur paanchon grades try karein.

note.en: The full picture behind brisk and absent reflexes.
note.ur: Brisk aur gayab reflexes ke peechay poori tasveer.
